issues.existing: a crowned figure seated on an ornate throne
issues.observed: a bare-headed figure with dark hair, head bowed low, seated on the throne — no crown is present
issues.evidence: The top of the head is silhouetted against a slightly lighter hillside and reads as a smooth, irregular mass of dark hair. There is no band, no points breaking the silhouette, and none of the hard specular glints that metal catches everywhere else in this image (the staff's orb and the throne carving both glint). The existing text's own uncertainty note already concedes it does not know whether a crown is worn, so the scene line asserts more than the pixels show.

issues.existing: high-backed throne with carved ram-head armrests
issues.observed: one carved ram head is visible on the throne's near front corner; the far arm is hidden behind the figure and cannot be counted
issues.evidence: A single ram head with curled horns is resolvable at the lower left on the throne's near arm/front corner, plus a second ram head inside the circular medallion on the backrest (already listed separately). The opposite armrest is entirely occluded by the seated figure's body and drapery, so the plural 'armrests' is not observable.
